sentences.text: Da jeg var ung, forsto jeg ikke hjertet mitt.
sentences.english: When I was young, I did not understand my heart.

sentences.text: Da jeg var ung, hadde jeg synd i hjertet.
sentences.english: When I was young, I had sin in my heart.
I did not believe in God.

sentences.text: En dag begynte jeg å forstå synden min.
sentences.english: One day I began to understand my sin.

sentences.text: Nå har jeg fred i hjertet.
sentences.english: Now I have peace in my heart.

sentences.text: Nå forstår jeg at Gud tilgir alle.
sentences.english: Now I understand that God forgives everyone.
